title: Affair
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: An 18+ anthology of adult boys' love stories. Yoshiyuki reunites with Okabe, his former baseball-club senior, still holding a grudge; half-brothers born at the same time navigate a yakuza family and a tangled relationship; two coworkers test their luck at mahjong; and a university student takes driving lessons from a fellow student. A bonus epilogue returns to the first couple.
life_message: Old grudges and rivalries can hide desire, and luck and honesty can turn them into love.
